title: SUBJECT
prompt:
SUBJECT
Adult South Korean woman in her early 20s. Natural Korean facial features, warm fair skin, and a short dark hairstyle. Maintain consistent facial features, skin tone, and hairstyle throughout the image.

Create a photorealistic vertical smartphone mirror selfie, matching the reference composition and body positioning.

POSE LOCK — HIGHEST PRIORITY
The woman sits on a beige stone floor directly in front of a tall, narrow, black-framed full-length mirror. Her back faces the camera at a three-quarter rear angle while her upper body turns slightly toward the mirror.

Both legs are folded naturally to her right side, with her hips resting on the floor. Her left hand is raised beside her face, touching her forehead as she looks into the mirror. Her right hand rests on the floor near her body for balance. Her head turns toward the mirror, showing only a partial side profile.

MIRROR REFLECTION — CRITICAL
The reflection must depict the exact same woman at the exact same moment, with anatomically consistent positioning. The reflected head, shoulders, arms, hands, torso, hips, and folded legs must correspond precisely to her real body and the mirror's geometry.

The raised hand must appear in the corresponding reflected position, and her reflected gaze must meet her own reflection. No second independent pose, front-facing duplicate, extra arms, or mismatched body orientation. The mirror must behave as a real reflective surface, not as a second camera view.

OUTFIT
Red-and-white horizontal striped triangle bikini top with thin white straps tied across the back. Loose black low-rise lounge pants resting below the waist, with a narrow red bikini waistband visible above the pants at the hips.

HAIR
Short dark hair, viewed primarily from behind. Keep the haircut consistent and natural. No long hair or substituted hairstyle.

ROOM
Warm minimalist dressing room with beige stone-patterned tile flooring, cream walls, pale wooden cabinetry with woven rattan panels, and a full-length mirror with a thin black frame.

A few makeup items and a white fabric accessory with black polka dots lie on the floor beside the mirror.

CAMERA AND LIGHTING
Fixed smartphone camera viewpoint, vertical 4:5 composition, natural indoor lighting, realistic perspective, subtle shadows, authentic mirror optics, natural skin texture, and candid lifestyle photography.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
Mismatched reflection, different pose in mirror, duplicated person, extra limbs, extra hands, incorrect hand placement, impossible mirror geometry, inconsistent body orientation, floating reflection, distorted anatomy, long hair, inconsistent appearance, CGI, illustration, text, watermark.
